introduction: Montana211 connects people with community resources through a statewide directory and telephone service.
description: Montana211 connects people with community resources through a statewide directory and telephone service.

sections.who: Anyone seeking local resources can request referrals. Providers determine eligibility and current availability.
sections.get: Specialists identify resources for food, housing, utilities and other needs. Referrals do not reserve funding.
